description: For a dynaset over F opened with LockEdits (the fourth argument, Options 0) in turn [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, -1, Null, "2"]: read Updatable and the LockEdits property; Edit, Errors, EditMode; assign N 5; Update; Errors; CancelUpdate; close. Asks the accepted lock-type values (1 dbOptimisticValue, 2 dbPessimistic, 3 dbOptimistic, 4 dbReadOnly, 5 dbOptimisticBatch), the LockEdits value each yields and whether writes are refused. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
